qe: What is the scientific name of the human being?
qh: मनुष्य का वैज्ञानिक नाम क्या है?
e: Concept: Scientific name ek do-shabd (binomial) naam hota hai - pehla word Genus (bada akshar) aur doosra Species (chhota akshar), aur ye Latinised hota hai. Insaan ka naam 'Homo sapiens' hai: Homo = genus (manushya jaisa), sapiens = species (samajhdar/wise). Baaki teen naam doosre jeevon ke hain: Homo erectus (purana insaan), Pan troglodytes (chimpanzee), Hylobates lar (gibbon). Exam point: 'Insaan = Homo sapiens; chimpanzee = Pan troglodytes'.

qe: The scientific name of mango is:
qh: आम का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Aam ka botanical naam Mangifera indica hai - Mangifera = genus (mango group), indica = species (India se related, kyunki aam ka desh India mana jata hai). Baaki teen doosre fal/paudhon ke hain: Solanum tuberosum (aalu), Musa paradisiaca (kela), Anacardium occidentale (kaju). Dhyaan rakhne wali baat: binomial naam hamesha do shabdon ka hota hai aur poora naam italics me likha jata hai (hath se likhte waqt underline). 'Indica' jaise species naam aksar us jagah ko batate hain jahan se jeev mila. Exam point: 'Aam = Mangifera indica (Genus Mangifera, species indica)'.

qe: The scientific name of wheat is:
qh: गेहूँ का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Gehun ka naam Triticum aestivum hai (Triticum genus = wheat ka poori family). Baaki teen anaaj ke naam hain: Oryza sativa (chawal/dhan), Zea mays (makka), Hordeum vulgare (jau). In teeno se gehun alag hai. 'Aestivum' Latin me 'summer' se juda hai - gehu rabi (sardi) ki mukhya fasal hai par iski kuch kismein summer me bhi hoti hai; gehu duniya ka bahut purana boya jane wala anaaj hai. Exam point: 'Gehun = Triticum aestivum; chawal = Oryza sativa; makka = Zea mays; jau = Hordeum vulgare'.

qe: The scientific name of rice is:
qh: चावल/धान का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Dhan (rice) ka naam Oryza sativa hai - Oryza genus me 20 se zyada kism hain, par jo hum khate hain wo Oryza sativa hai (esme indica aur japonica wali kismein hoti hain). Baaki teen: Triticum aestivum (gehun), Saccharum officinarum (ganna), Pennisetum typhoides (bajra). Chawal duniya ki aadhi se zyada aabadi ka mukhya anaaj hai; Bharat me Bengal, UP aur Punjab sabse zyada chawal paida karte hain. 'Oryza' naam Greek shabd 'oruza' se aaya hai. Exam point: 'Chawal = Oryza sativa (rice); 'sativa' matlab 'boya gaya (ugaya gaya/fasal)''.

qe: The scientific name of potato is:
qh: आलू का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Aalu ka naam Solanum tuberosum hai - 'tuberosum' isliye kyunki ye paudhe ke zameen ke neeche wale phule hue tane (tuber) ko khate hain. Solanum genus me tamatar aur mirch bhi aate hain. Baaki teen: Solanum lycopersicum (tamatar), Ipomoea batatas (shakarkandi/sweet potato), Daucus carota (gaajar). Dhyaan do: aalu ka khane wala hissa jad nahi balki zameen ke andar badla hua 'tana' (stem tuber) hai - isi par chhoti 'aankhen' (eyes/kaliyan) dikhti hain jinse naya paudha ugta hai. Aalu South America (Peru) se duniya me faila. Exam point: 'Aalu = Solanum tuberosum; tamatar = Solanum lycopersicum'.

qe: The scientific name of sunflower is:
qh: सूरजमुखी का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Surajmukhi ka naam Helianthus annuus hai - Helianthus = 'sun flower' (Helios = suraj, anthus = phool) aur annuus = 'saalana' (annual plant jo ek saal me poora jeevan poora karta hai). Baaki teen alag phool hain: Tagetes erecta (genda), Rosa indica (gulab), Hibiscus rosa-sinensis (gudhal). Surajmukhi ke phool ka 'head' asal me sainkdon chhote phoolon (florets) ka samuh hota hai - isliye ye 'composite' family (Asteraceae) me aata hai; iske beej se tel nikalta hai aur bhoosi pashuon ka khana banti hai. Exam point: 'Surajmukhi = Helianthus annuus (Helios = suraj, anthos = phool)'.

qe: The scientific name of neem is:
qh: नीम का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Neem ka naam Azadirachta indica hai - iska har hissa (patte, chhaal, beej ka tel) dawa aur keet-nashak (biopesticide) ke liye mashhoor hai. Baaki teen doosre ped hain: Ficus religiosa (peepal), Mangifera indica (aam), Tectona grandis (sagwan). Iska khaas padarth 'azadirachtin' keede ko khaana band kar deta hai aur badhne nahi deta - isi liye neem ka tel anaj ke bhandaar (grain storage) me keeton se bachav ke liye purane samay se use hota hai. Exam point: 'Neem = Azadirachta indica (dawa + biopesticide ka ped)'.

qe: The scientific name of the lotus is:
qh: कमल का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Kamal ka naam Nelumbo nucifera hai; 'nucifera' matlab 'akhrot jaisa beej dene wala' (lotus ke beej katora jaisa banta hai). Kamal ka patta paani ko dhakel deta hai (lotus effect) isliye wahi geele nahi hote - isi wajah se ye saaf paani ka phool maana jata hai. Baaki teen: Nymphaea alba (kumud/water lily, kamal se alag), Rosa indica (gulab), Lilium (lily). Exam point: 'Kamal = Nelumbo nucifera (kaumudi/water lily = Nymphaea, alag hai)'.

qe: The scientific name of the garden pea, the plant used by Mendel, is:
qh: मटर (जिस पर मेंडल ने काम किया) का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Matar ka naam Pisum sativum hai - Mendel ne vanshagat (genetics) ke niyam isi paudhe par khole the kyunki iske guna saaf-saaf do roopon me milte hain (lamba/chhota, gol/jhurridaar). Baaki teen doosri daal-fasalein hain: Lathyrus odoratus (sweet pea - isme bhi genetics experiments hue), Cicer arietinum (chana), Vicia faba (bakla/beans). Matar ke 7 'contrasting traits' (lamba-chhota, gol-jhurridaar, hari-peeli phali) hi Mendel ki safalta ka raaz the - har gun ka do hi saaf roop tha, isliye natiije gine ja sakte the. Exam point: 'Matar = Pisum sativum (Mendel ka experimental plant)'.

qe: The scientific name of the lion is:
qh: शेर का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Sher (lion) ka naam Panthera leo hai - Panthera ek genus hai jisme bade billi (big cats) aate hain. Baaki teen: Panthera tigris (baagh/tiger), Felis domesticus (gharelu billi), Canis lupus (bhediya/wolf). Dhyaan rakhne ka tarika: same genus 'Panthera' par species alag - leo = sher, tigris = baagh. Ek aasan tarika: teen mashhoor bade billi ke naam isi Panthera genus me hain - leo (sher), tigris (baagh), pardus (tendua); jabki chhoti billi apne alag genus Felis me aati hai. Bharat me sher ab sirf Gir (Gujarat) me bache hain. Exam point: 'Sher = Panthera leo; Baagh = Panthera tigris'.

qe: The scientific name of the tiger is:
qh: बाघ का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Baagh (tiger) ka naam Panthera tigris hai. Baaki teen bhi badi billiyan hain par alag: Panthera leo (sher), Panthera pardus (tendua/leopard), Neofelis nebulosa (clouded leopard). Yaad rakho: genus bada akshar (Panthera), species chhota (tigris) - binomial ka usool yahi hai. Bharat me baagh ki kai upjatiyan (sub-species) hain par sabhi Panthera tigris ke andar aati hain; Bengal tiger (Panthera tigris tigris) sabse mashhoor hai. Baagh 29 July ko 'Global Tiger Day' se joda jata hai. Exam point: 'Bharat ka rashtriya pashu baagh = Panthera tigris'.

qe: The scientific name of the Indian elephant is:
qh: भारतीय हाथी का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Bharat/Asia ke hathi ka naam Elephas maximus hai (maximus = sabse bada). Africa ka hathi alag genus Loxodonta africana hai - uske kaan bade aur lambi daant dono gender me hote hain, jabki Asian hathi me aamtaur par sirf nar me tusks hote hain. Baaki teen: Loxodonta africana (African elephant), Rhinoceros unicornis (ek-singh wala gainda), Hippopotamus amphibius (dariya ka ghoda). Exam point: 'Asian hathi = Elephas maximus; African = Loxodonta africana'.

qe: The scientific name of the Indian bullfrog is:
qh: भारतीय बुलफ्रॉग का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Indian bullfrog ka naam Rana tigrina hai (Rana = genus jisme sachche mendhak aate hain; 'tigrina' uske dhabbe/pattern ke kaaran). Baaki teen: Rana temporaria (Europe ka mendhak), Bufo melanostictus (Indian toad/bhaunkar mendhak - alag genus Bufo), Hyla arborea (paed par rehne wala mendhak, tree frog). Rana genus ke mendhak paani ke kareeb rehte hain aur unki chamdi nem hoti hai; Bufo (toad/bhaunkar mendhak) sookhi bhurbhur chamdi wala alag genus hai. Isliye 'frog' aur 'toad' ko ek na samjho. Exam point: 'Frog = Rana; Toad = Bufo (dono amphibian par alag genus)'.

qe: The scientific name of the Indian cobra is:
qh: भारतीय नाग (कोबरा) का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Indian cobra ka naam Naja naja hai - ye bharat ke 'big four' zehrilay saanpon me se ek hai (baaki: Russell's viper, common krait, saw-scaled viper). Baaki teen doosre zehrilay saanp hain: Ophiophagus hannah (king cobra - alag genus), Bungarus caeruleus (common krait), Daboia russelii (Russell's viper). Cobra ka phan (hood) gardan ki pasliyan failane se banta hai; uska zehar 'neurotoxic' hota hai jo saans ki nason ko kharab karta hai. Anti-venom banane ke liye saanp ka zehar ghode me inject karke antibody banaye jate hain. Exam point: 'Cobra = Naja naja; King cobra = Ophiophagus hannah'.

qe: The scientific name of the common housefly is:
qh: आम घरेलू मक्खी का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Ghar ki makkhi (housefly) ka naam Musca domestica hai (Musca = fly genus). Baaki teen khaas mosquitoes ke naam hain - ye bimariyon se jude hain: Anopheles (malaria), Culex (filariasis/haathipaun), Aedes aegypti (dengue, chikungunya, zika). Bimari ke saath genus ka jod yaad rakho: 'Anopheles' (malaria), 'Aedes' (dengue), 'Culex' (filariasis). Makkhi apne pairon par bacteria chipka kar khaane par baithti hai isliye wo typhoid aur cholera jaise rog bhi phailati hai. Exam point: 'Housefly = Musca domestica; Anopheles = malaria; Aedes = dengue; Culex = filariasis'.

qe: The scientific name of the honeybee (Indian bee) is:
qh: मधुमक्खी (भारतीय मधुमक्खी) का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Bharatiya madhumakkhi ka naam Apis indica hai (Api = bee). Baaki teen note: Apis dorsata (badi/himalayan giant honeybee - bharat ki sabse badi), Musca domestica (gharelu makkhi), Bombyx mori (resham ki keedi/silkworm). Bharat me 4 mukhya kismein paali jati hain: Apis indica, Apis mellifera (European - sabse zyada shahad), Apis dorsata (sabse badi) aur Apis florea (sabse chhoti). Ek chhatte me ek 'queen' (rani), kuch 'drones' (nar) aur hazaaron 'workers' (kaamgar) hoti hain. Exam point: 'Apiculture (madhumakkhi paalan) = Apis (indica, mellifera, dorsata) ki kismein'.

qe: The scientific name of the common earthworm (used in vermicomposting) is:
qh: केंचुए का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Khechua (earthworm) ka naam Pheretima posthuma hai - ye mitti khaakar bekaar padarth ko turant khaad me badal deta hai, isi liye ise 'kisan ka dost' kehte hain aur vermicompost (khechua khaad) isse banate hain. Baaki teen alag kirmi hain: Hirudinaria granulosa (joouk/leech), Ascaris lumbricoides (roundworm), Taenia solium (tapeworm). Khechue ke sharir par 'setae' (chhote khurdare baal) hote hain jo mitti me pakad banane me madad karte hain; 'clitellum' (band wala hissa) ande dene ke kaam aata hai. Uska khoon laal hota hai kyunki usme haemoglobin paani me ghuli halat me hota hai. Exam point: 'Khechua = Pheretima posthuma (vermicompost banane wala)'.

qe: The scientific name of Amoeba is:
qh: अमीबा का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Amoeba ek ek-koshikiya (unicellular) jeev hai jo apna aakar badal kar 'pseudopodia' (jhoothe paanv) nikalti hai; iska poora sharir ek hi cell hota hai jisme khana pustibhand (vacuole) me pachta hai. Iska naam Amoeba proteus hai (Proteus ek Greek devta tha jo apna roop badal leta tha - isi liye). Baaki teen doosre protozoans hain: Paramecium (chappal jaisa), Euglena (paudha-janwar ka jod), Plasmodium (malaria). Exam point: 'Amoeba proteus = apna aakar badalne wala ek-koshikiya jeev'.

qe: The scientific name of the button mushroom is:
qh: बटन मशरूम का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Button mushroom ka naam Agaricus bisporus hai - ye ek khane wala fungus hai jo khaas taur par khaad/mitti wale compost par ugaya jata hai; iska mukhya khane wala hissa 'fruiting body' hota hai (jangal me ugane wala wo chhata). Baaki teen doosre fungus hain: Penicillium notatum (jisse penicillin dawa banti hai), Aspergillus niger (black mould), Saccharomyces cerevisiae (yeast/bread-beer wala fungus). Exam point: 'Mushroom = Agaricus bisporus (khane wala fungus)'.

qe: The scientific name of the Indian one-horned rhinoceros is:
qh: भारतीय एक-सींग वाले गैंडे का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Ek-singh wale Indian gaende ka naam Rhinoceros unicornis hai; ye khaas Assam (Kaziranga region) me paaya jata hai, iski chamdi moti plate jaisi hoti hai aur sirf ek singh hoti hai (Africa ke gaende me do singh hoti hain). Baaki teen doosre bade jeev hain: Elephas maximus (Asian elephant), Bos gaurus (gaur/Indian bison), Panthera tigris (tiger). Exam point: 'Ek-singh wala gaenda = Rhinoceros unicornis (unicornis = ek singh)'.

qe: The scientific name of maize (makka) is:
qh: मक्का का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Makka ka naam Zea mays hai - iske dane bade peele aur bhutte ke dono taraf saf me lagte hain, ise 'corn' bhi kehte hain. Iska istemal aata (makki ki roti), tel aur animal feed ke liye hota hai; iske alag-alag roop (yellow, sweet corn, popcorn) hote hain. Baaki teen: Triticum aestivum (gehun), Oryza sativa (chawal), Sorghum vulgare (jowar). Makka duniya ki sabse zyada paida ki jane wali anaaj fasal hai; iske dane se makki ka aata, corn oil, corn syrup aur ethanol bhi banta hai. Isme 'zein' naam ka protein hota hai, isliye makki ka gluten (gehu wala protein) alag hota hai. Exam point: 'Makka = Zea mays (maize/corn)'.

qe: The scientific name of the tea plant is:
qh: चाय के पौधे का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Chai ke paudhe ka naam Camellia sinensis hai - iske kori (young) patton aur kaliyan (buds) tod kar usme fungal oxidation (khaas processing) karte hain; isse safed, hari aur kaali chai banti hai (processing ka farq). Ye paudha Assam aur Darjeeling ki pahariyon me bahut hota hai. Baaki teen: Coffea arabica (coffee), Theobroma cacao (chocolate/cocoa), Saccharum officinarum (ganna). Exam point: 'Chai = Camellia sinensis; Coffee = Coffea arabica'.

qe: The scientific name of the rubber plant is:
qh: रबड़ के पौधे का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Rubber ke paudhe ka naam Hevea brasiliensis hai - iski chhaal (bark) me khaas doodh jaisa taral (latex) hota hai jise 'tapping' se nikalte hain; ise process karke natural rubber banate hain. Ye South America (Brazil) ka paudha hai jo aaj Kerala-Aasam me ugaya jata hai. Baaki teen: Ficus elastica (doosra rubber-yielding ped), Camellia sinensis (chai), Gossypium hirsutum (kapas). Exam point: 'Rubber = Hevea brasiliensis (latex se)'.

qe: The scientific name of the silkworm is:
qh: रेशम कीट (सिल्कवर्म) का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Resham banane wali keedia (silkworm) ka naam Bombyx mori hai - iska larva khaas paudhe (mulberry ke patte) khakar sharir me fibroin protein banata hai aur unhe ''koya'' (cocoon) me lapet leta hai; insaan us cocoon se resham nikalta hai (reeling) - isi paalan ko sericulture kehte hain. Baaki teen: Apis indica (madhummakhi), Laccifer lacca (lac keedia), Drosophila melanogaster (fruit fly, genetics ki khog). Exam point: 'Silkworm = Bombyx mori (sericulture ke liye)'.

qe: The scientific name of the domestic cat is:
qh: घरेलू बिल्ली का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Ghar ki billi ka naam Felis domesticus hai - ye 'Felis' genotype (chhoti billiyon ka genus) ka member hai. Baaki teen: Panthera leo (sher), Canis familiaris (kutta), Panthera tigris (baagh) - teeno alag genus me hain. Ghar ki billi aur jungle ki chhoti billi dono 'Felis' genus me aati hain (small cats); badi billiyan - sher, baagh, tendua - 'Panthera' genus me aati hain kyunki unke gale ki haddi (hyoid) bolne nahi deti. Yahi farq exam me poocha jata hai. Exam point: 'Billi = Felis domesticus; kutta = Canis familiaris; sher = Panthera leo'.

qe: The scientific name of the dog is:
qh: कुत्ते का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Kutte ka naam Canis familiaris hai; ye bhediya (wolf) ki hi jati se aaya hai isliye kai jagah ise 'Canis lupus familiaris' likha jata hai (Canis lupus = bhediya). Baaki teen: Felis domesticus (billi), Canis lupus (bhediya/wolf), Vulpes vulpes (lomdi/fox). Kutta insaan ka sabse pehla paltu (domesticated) jaanvar mana jata hai. Uski sungne ki shakti insaan se kai guna zyada hoti hai isliye police-sniffer aur rescue dogs ka istemal hota hai; uski kai naslein (breeds) insaan ne hi banayi hain. Exam point: 'Kutta = Canis familiaris (bhediya se juda); lomdi = Vulpes vulpes'.

qe: The scientific name of cotton is:
qh: कपास का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
e: Concept: Kapas ka paudha Gossypium genus ka hai (sabse aam khaiti: Gossypium hirsutum). Iske beej ke aas-paas ugne wale safed reshe (fibres) hi kapda banane ke kaam aate hain - ye reshe mainly cellulose ke hote hain. Baaki teen doosre reshe/paudhe hain: Corchorus capsularis (patson/pata), Linum usitatissimum (alsi - jisse flax fibre), Saccharum officinarum (ganna). Exam point: 'Kapas = Gossypium; jute = Corchorus; pat-fi fibre wale plants'.

qe: In a binomial scientific name, the first word denotes the:
qh: द्विपद (binomial) वैज्ञानिक नाम में पहला शब्द किसका सूचक होता है?
e: Concept: Binomial nomenclature me naam do hisson ka hota hai - pehla 'genus' (bada akshar se) aur doosra 'species' (chhote akshar se); jaise Mangifera indica me Mangifera = genus (aam ka samuh) aur indica = species (us samuh ki khaas kism). Ye system Linnaeus ne diya tha jisme har jeev ka naam do shabdon me likha jata hai (aur aaj bhi used hota hai). Baaki teen ranks naam me nahi likhte: Family, Order bade group hote hain. Exam point: 'Binomial naam ka pehla shabd = Genus, doosra = Species'.

qe: According to the rules of binomial nomenclature, the species name is written with:
qh: द्विपद नामकरण के नियमों के अनुसार प्रजाति (species) नाम लिखा जाता है:
oe: A capital letter like the genus
oh: A capital letter like the genus
e: Concept: Binomial naam likhne ke usool: (1) Genus ka pehla akshar bada (capital), (2) species ka poora naam chhota (small letters) - jaise 'Mangifera indica' me indica chhota hai, (3) poora naam akshar (italics) me likha jata hai (print me) ya underline kiya jata hai (likhit/hath se). Ye niyam isliye banaya gaya ki koi bhi confusion na ho ki kaun sa shabd genus hai. Baaki teen options galat hain. Exam point: 'Genus = Capital, species = small; poora naam italic me'.

qe: In the scientific name 'Mangifera indica', the word 'indica' denotes the:
qh: 'मैंगिफेरा इंडिका' में 'इंडिका' क्या दर्शाता है?
e: Concept: Kisi bhi binomial naam me pehla shabd genus aur doosra shabd species hota hai - isliye Mangifera indica me Mangifera = genus (aam ka samuh) aur indica = species ka naam, jo yahan ye batata hai ki ye species India se hai/India me payi jaati hai (indic = India). Aise descriptive species naam ki kai misaalein hain: indica, sativa (ugaya gaya/cultivated), officinarum (davaon wala), tigrina (dhabbe wala). Baaki teen galat hain. Exam point: 'Pehla shabd = Genus, doosra = Species (jaise indica = species)'.
